lede: The big one this week is Thursday's Planning and Zoning Commission meeting, where three Town-owned development projects — including the Carhenge Redevelopment at 700 W Pacific Ave — are up for subdivision and concept review, all in the Accommodations 2 zone. Same day, SMART's board votes on two vendor contracts tied to the gondola structural analysis, which keeps that bridge-or-bust project moving. Later in the week, the Gondola Leadership Committee meets Monday on funding commitments and next steps, and Town Council convenes a special session to hear a liquor permit request for KOTO's Live at the Drive event.

notable.stake: Town votes on Carhenge subdivision and two other Town-owned development concept reviews.
Board votes to award gondola structural analysis contracts — key to project's future.
Public hearing on KOTO's Live at the Drive liquor permit; public may attend.
Gondola committee takes action on CIG funding commitments and project direction.
